description: Read one matter correspondence record with its filers and attachments. When intake is not direct, from, to, and the message date (sentAt) are asserted by the forwarder and are not verified; authentication verdicts in authenticatedSender describe the delivery, not the extracted original. A record whose source is upload was read from the file sourceEntityId in the matter (an email file, or a data-box .zfo file); its headers are as stated in that file and are not verified. A data_box record carries its envelope in dataBox, the files of the message as attachments, and in dataBoxContacts the organization contacts whose data boxes list the sender or recipient box ID (null on email).
